description: Akaryakıt İstasyonları is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı. İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi’nin görev ve yetki alanında bulunan ruhsatlı akaryakıt istasyonlarının faaliyet konusu (Akaryakıt / LPG / CNG), konum bilgisi ve bayisi olduğu dağıtım şirketlerine ait harita tabanlı veri setidir. Coverage: Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include akaryakıt, akaryakıt istasyonu, fuel, mekansal veri, spatial data. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
